eps.ov: Dennis, cast out of a top-tier adventuring party, decides to follow his dreams and open his own restaurant.
The Adventurer's Restaurant is open at last, and their first customer is...someone wearing full plate armor?!
A boy named Vivia comes to the restaurant. He's been cast out of his party, so he may deign to join a new one.

eps.t: Then, I'll Have the Daily Special
eps.ov: Bachel has been thoroughly ground down by her crushing workload. Then another scolding pushes her to the edge.

eps.t: It's Too Soon for a Marriage Proposal!
eps.ov: The restaurant is booming, but Dennis is worried about Atelier! Katie approaches Dennis with a request.
The Workstatt family butler arrives to retrieve Atelier. He tells Dennis and the others of her tragic past.
The restaurant is packed, but Dennis falls ill. As he dreams of his youth, the others try to cook for him.

eps.t: Today, We Are Closed for Business Reasons
eps.ov: It's a cause for celebration as three of the regulars at the restaurant have acquired new jobs. While the group soaks in the hot springs and enjoys some barbecue, a shadow lurks around the temporarily closed establishment.

eps.t: If It's Important to You, Then Please Don't Let Go of It!
eps.ov: Dennis and Atelier decide to leave town to protect their friends, but familiar figures block their way.

eps.t: The Higher and Further Away a Place Is, the More I Aim to Reach It
eps.ov: Dennis and the others continue preparing for battle. Vigo thinks back on what he's done to get this far.
